Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.overview: Arabinogalactan is a polysaccharide extracted with water from Western larch wood. Its galactose and arabinose units occur in an approximate six-to-one ratio. The specified food functions include emulsifying, stabilising, binding and adding body. FDA lists applications in essential-oil preparations, non-nutritive sweeteners, flavour bases, certain dressings and pudding mixes.
more_info.origin: Produced by water extraction from Western larch wood. The recovered plant polysaccharide contains galactose and arabinose units in the specified ratio. The FDA definition describes a wood-derived preparation, rather than an animal or mineral material.
more_info.uses: FDA lists essential-oil preparations, non-nutritive sweeteners, flavour bases, certain dressings and pudding mixes. Functions include emulsification, stabilisation, binding and adding body, using the minimum amount needed for the intended effect.
